questions.question: Solve the simultaneous equations: 2x + y = 11 and x - y = 1.

solutionSteps.text: From x - y = 1, rearrange to x = y + 1.
Substitute x = y + 1 into 2x + y = 11 to get 2(y + 1) + y = 11.
Substitute y = 3 into x = y + 1, giving x = 4.

imStuckLadder.prompt: Rearrange one equation so a variable is by itself.
Use x = y + 1 and replace x in the other equation.
Expand, simplify, and solve for y before finding x.
Try the same substitution method in a snack or ticket context.

Substitute T = 2B + 4 into T + B = 31, giving 3B + 4 = 31, so B = 9.
